17348               	; 	INCLUDE "art.bas"
17349               	; 	' Keystone Kapers art -- GENERATED by assets/genart.py. Do not edit; regenerate.
17350               	; 	'
17351               	; 	' EVERY SPRITE IS 16x16: sprite size and magnification are GLOBAL on the
17352               	; 	' TMS9918, so small objects are drawn small INSIDE a 16x16 box rather than
17353               	; 	' being small sprites.
17354               	; 	'
17355               	; 	' EVERY 8-PX OBJECT SITS IN ROWS 8-15 OF ITS BOX, ducked Kelly included, so
17356               	; 	' one rule places them all: bottom edge = y + 16, and a thing resting on the
17357               	; 	' floor is at y = FLOORY - 16.
17358               	; 	'
17359               	; 	' Sprite bytes are QUADRANT-ORDERED: 16 rows of the left half, then 16 of
17360               	; 	' the right. Every block is an EVEN number of bytes -- an odd DATA BYTE run
17361               	; 	' silently misaligns every word table after it (CLAUDE.md 3A).
17362               	;
17363               	; spr_kelly:	' Kelly: RIGHT hat/face/two merged run bodies/two FREE slots/duck hat/face/body, then the same LEFT (+36). The run bodies carry tunic AND legs, so a frame is one sprite, and standing is run frame 1. Patterns 0..68

18478               	; 	' -------------------------------------------------- scanner canvas
18479               	; 	' Chars 208-255: 16 cols x 3 rows over screen rows 21-23. Blank to start;
18480               	; 	' dots are plotted by VPOKEing the PATTERN table (rows 21-23 sit in the
18481               	; 	' third screen third, so every scanner pattern is at base 4096).
18482               	;
18483               	; 	' --------------------------------------------------- font colours
18484               	; 	' Chars 32-90, EIGHT bytes each. Without this the font keeps whatever
18485               	; 	' CVBasic left in the colour table, which on a green store made the HUD
18486               	; 	' unreadable.

18597               	; 	'
18598               	; 	' EIGHT band templates of 5 rows x 32 cols (160 bytes each) plus a 32-byte
18599               	; 	' index over (level, screen). The whole 8-screen, 4-level building is about
18600               	; 	' 1.3 KB instead of the 5,120 bytes it would cost to store literally.
18601               	; 	'
18602               	; 	' All eight templates are ONE contiguous block under ONE label, so a band
18603               	; 	' blit is
18604               	; 	'     SCREEN stor_tpl, tpl*160, toprow*32, 32, 5, 32
18605               	; 	' with no label ladder -- SCREEN needs a literal label and a label cannot be
18606               	; 	' chosen by a variable, which is why RallyX needed a 4-way IF over its maze
18607               	; 	' tables. One block sidesteps it.
18608               	; 	'
18609               	; 	' 160 is EVEN, so this cannot leave the location counter odd and misalign
18610               	; 	' the word tables defined after it.
18611               	; 	'
18612               	; 	' template ids:
18613               	; 	'   0 T_AISLE_A
18614               	; 	'   1 T_AISLE_B
18615               	; 	'   2 T_ESC_W
18616               	; 	'   3 T_ESC_E
18617               	; 	'   4 T_ELEV
18618               	; 	'   5 T_ROOF0
18619               	; 	'   6 T_ROOF1
18620               	; 	'   7 T_ROOF2
18621               	; 	'   8 T_ROOF3
18622               	; 	'   9 T_ROOF4
18623               	; 	'   10 T_ROOF5
18624               	; 	'   11 T_ROOF6
18625               	; 	'   12 T_ROOF7
18626               	; 	'   13 T_END_W
18627               	; 	'   14 T_END_E
18628               	;
18629               	; stor_tpl:	' 15 templates x 160 bytes

19245               	;
19246               	; 	' THE SKYLINE'S LAST BAND WITHOUT ITS YELLOW, high nibble ink, low nibble
19247               	; 	' paper, one byte a scan line -- the same shape genart emits into
19248               	; 	' store_col. SKY2 is white-on-9 throughout instead of turning to paper 10
19249               	; 	' at row 4; BLDGL holds its blue one row longer and then meets its own
19250               	; 	' grey wall. Both are the generated bytes with 10 replaced by 9 and
19251               	; 	' nothing else changed. See setup_rest.
19252               	; #if NES
19253               	; nes_sky2c:
19254               	; 	DATA BYTE $F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9
19255               	; nes_bldlc:
19256               	; 	DATA BYTE $B9,$B9,$B9,$B9,$B9,$BE,$BE,$BE
19257               	; #endif
19258               	;
19259               	; 	' THE IN-GAME FONT'S COLOUR, one byte a scan line and eight a character for
19260               	; 	' all 59 of them. $B4 is light yellow on dark blue -- ink index 3, paper index 1 --
19261               	; 	' and which colours those are is then the attribute table's business, per
19262               	; 	' region: dark blue behind the HUD, the store's green behind a message box.
19263               	; 	'
19264               	; 	' 472 bytes of one repeated value. That reads like waste and is the cheap
19265               	; 	' option: ROM is three budgets here and this is not the scarce one, while
19266               	; 	' the alternative is a second font (impossible -- only eleven free codes)
19267               	; 	' or a new uploader parameter (no RAM -- two bytes left).
19268               	; #if NES
19269               	; nes_fcol:
